* Result

* Result

No code change, and the image is deliberately not gated.

=ores_schema.png= and =ores_schema.cmapx= are rendered by whatever PlantUML
build is installed, and PlantUML writes layout coordinates into them. They are
therefore not reproducible across machines: a check that regenerated them and
compared bytes would fail everywhere except the machine that last rendered it,
and committing a local render would churn the file on every developer's box.

The =.puml= is the artifact that is gated, and it is regenerated by the two
python commands the drift workflow runs. That is why the account picture code
appeared in the diagram's source and not in the picture, and why the picture
was left alone.

The stale image is already captured: sprint 26 filed =fix-the-er-diagram-png-render=
for it, including that the render overflows a 32-bit pixel count at 367 tables.
This task reduces to that capture, so it closes without action rather than
adding a second one.
